scripts.dev: corepack pnpm dev:prepare && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @exam/api --filter @exam/web dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @exam/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/web build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @exam/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/web typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm test:tooling && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/api test && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/web test
scripts.test:integration: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/p0-api.test.cjs tests/p1-api.test.cjs tests/p1-migration.test.cjs tests/p2-api.test.cjs tests/git-review-api.test.cjs tests/ui-admin-api.test.cjs tests/ui-teacher-api.test.cjs tests/ui-student-api.test.cjs tests/ui-results-api.test.cjs
scripts.test:e2e: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/p0-browser.test.cjs tests/p1-browser.test.cjs tests/p2-browser.test.cjs tests/git-review-browser.test.cjs tests/ui-foundation.test.cjs tests/ui-admin.test.cjs tests/ui-teacher.test.cjs tests/ui-student.test.cjs tests/ui-workspace.test.cjs tests/ui-results.test.cjs
scripts.dev:prepare: corepack pnpm db:generate && corepack pnpm --filter @exam/shared build
